g.text: E02 - independent watchdog / latch / relay drivers. 3.3V + 5V regulated inputs only.

g.desc: E02 - independent watchdog / latch / relay drivers. 3.3V + 5V regulated inputs only.

g.text: LOCAL_OK = watchdog + 3.3V/5V supervisors. ANALOG_OK must qualify ALL audio rails; E05 requires +/-19V and +/-12V.

g.desc: LOCAL_OK = watchdog + 3.3V/5V supervisors. ANALOG_OK must qualify ALL audio rails; E05 requires +/-19V and +/-12V.

g.text: U3 Q remains cleared after a fault until a fresh MCU permit rising edge. D28 may monitor ARMED.

g.desc: U3 Q remains cleared after a fault until a fresh MCU permit rising edge. D28 may monitor ARMED.

g.text: J4/J5 each drive two parallel G6K-2F-Y DC5 coils on the audio carrier. No audio contacts are on this sheet.

g.text: D1/D2: cathode to drain, anode to GND. Verify coil energy, clamp overshoot, release time and local decoupling on bench.
